column4: My unit that kills an enemy in the front row is copied by a copy card into a second cell; the copy attacks the next front enemy, the enemy cannot answer on my turn, and each kill fires its onkill gain twice.
I make both players discard a card from hand; my discarded unit with a discard effect returns or grows at once, while the enemy loses a card and cannot answer; the enemy discards nothing useful.
A spell is cast and a hidden unit reacts to it, but the hide has no part in the reaction; any spell-watcher would do.
column5: faeria: Key of the Guardians + Aurora's Disciple

column4: A revive card brings a dead unit back into a front cell; its Place effect creates a card in my hand again, so each revival yields a new card the enemy could not stop.
A revived unit enters a lane and a weaken effect acts there, but the weakening is a separate card and does not need the revival.
column5: duelyst: Keeper of the Vale + Arclyte Sentinel

column4: My unit with a Death effect that equips or summons a carrier dies; the death attaches an item or unit to another unit, which grows from being attached, so dying feeds the attach.
A unit with a Place ping dies and lands in the discard pile; a recycle card returns it to hand, I place it again, and its Place ping hits a wounded enemy front unit once more.
An attached item or unit goes on a carrier and a shield effect also hits that carrier, but the cards just stack; neither changes what the other does.
A returner takes my unit with a Place that takes control of a weak enemy back to hand; the enemy cannot answer on my turn; I place it again and its Place seizes another enemy unit.
I return a unit whose Place gains supply and place it again for more supply, but the return itself does nothing with supply for most pairs; the rest are generic.
A cost reducer makes two units fit in one round's supply; each unit placed triggers my watcher on the grid, and the cheaper cards make the watcher fire more times.
column5: faeria: Mother of All Yaks + Illusion of Grandeur

column4: My unit with an attack effect and strikes-twice attacks the enemy front cell: its attack effect fires on each of its two paid attacks, so the effect is doubled.
I cast a shield spell on a front unit; the cast triggers my spell-watcher unit, which grows or acts, and the shielded front unit survives the enemy's next attack.
A draw card pulls cards and puts a spent card back into the deck; a recycle card returns the discards, so I draw into the same strong cards again each round.
A damage spell wounds an enemy front unit; my unit with a ping text finishes it, and the kill triggers its gain, so small hits and spell damage split one removal.
I attach an equipment unit that gives my spells +1 damage; its carrier stands in my camp; a damage spell then hits one point harder and kills a unit it would only wound.
